artifact_copy_policy: runs/ and review/ retain source bytes; build excerpts and identity files are new read-only extractions. Source paths in logs and commands are their original execution locations, not relative archive paths. Reproduction uses repository scripts in docs/experiments/legacy-lfo-oracle; no script was relocated into evidence. No tests were rerun while archiving.

completed_full_suite.scope: Complete configured core-only default CTest suite. This is not plugin, GUI, native-installation or DAW qualification.

review_scope: Independent source review and focused GCC native execution; independent coefficient and revived-eligibility binary reruns; final checker parser and seven-log review. No independent rerun of the full compiler/sanitizer/full-suite matrix is attributed.
diagnosis_scope: Historical diagnostic copies of baseline CoreTests and speed probes. Their report predates the preregistered repair; its proposed-next-step text is not the final test contract. The noinline probe is a diagnostic control, not a portable fix. The copied source files are not registered or built by the repository. Binaries and disassembly are excluded and separately hashed.
